title: About
text: I am a Professor of Biological Sciences at the University of Southern Maine with a background in geometric morphometrics, biomechanical modeling of swimming and flying animals, and modeling performance trade-offs in functional systems. More recently, I’ve worked on developing tools for best statistical practices in bench biology.

title: Jeff Walker
text:
Statistics for the Experimental Bench Biologist: Best practice workflows using R is guide to implementing better statistical analyses and workflows than commonly employed in the wet bench biological sciences.
Data From is a blog-style site re-analyzing data from the wet-bench biology literature to demonstrate better practices.
R doodles is a blog-style site exploring statistical concepts, mostly in ecology, using R.
Physics for Biologists is book containing very short chapter on some specific topics useful when teaching physiology.
